definition: [ מָרוֺד , Kö il. l, 127 f. ] noun [masculine] restlessness, straying (?); — suffix עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי Lam 3:19 plural suffix יְמֵי עָנְיָהּ וּמְרוּדֶיהָ Lam 1:7 (read probably מְרוּדָהּ Nö ZMG xxxvii (1883), 539 ); plural וַעֲנִיִּם מְרוּדִים Isa 58:7 , usually concrete the wandering (homeless) poor ( Di thinks old Qal passive Participle; Che Comm. reads Hoph`al מוּרָדִים ; Buhl Lex Hiph`il מָרִידִים ; Kö ii. 1, 128 takes ᵑ0 abstract for concrete [apposition of ׳ וַע ]; so Du Che Hpt [ ׳ וַע gloss], read perhaps participle רָדִים ( מ dittograph)).
